origin: U201 body center, relative Cartesian top coordinates with antenna +Y

edge.orientation: local +Y faces air; host outline can run across or recess to this line
edge.reference: nearest pad outer edge y=3.05 mm (manufacturer 1mm land); 0.90 mm land-edge

keepouts.name: U201 antenna, no carrier copper/traces/vias, mount or silkscreen
U201 antenna clearance to other metal and parts, keep display frame, solar wires, screws, battery and enclosure metal away

layout_notes: Use local return/ground stitching in the electronic body. Do not add a host-side antenna or a 50 ohm trace.
Bring pins 30 and 31 and center pins 37 to 40 into connected local ground and then both planes, via-in-pad only if filled/capped. Route other pins outward from electronic end when possible.
Place 100n C201 beside U201.9/.10. Use continuous bottom ground below module body except essential short fanout. Do not put EPD switching nodes or the RT6160 inductor below or beside U201.

Place J201 on the top, out of the glass and cable path, with contact fixture access. Pogo can be moved independently of module; ensure fixture approach in enclosure or provide explicit uncovered factory fixture access.
If placing larger clearance to nearby exterior metal, keep it outside the antenna region, not inside the shield/ground counterpoise.
